units.axes: model space: +Y down, -Z is the front of the entity, -X is its right side
units.rotation: radians; a part applies Z, then Y, then X to its parent frame (a vertex is turned about X first)
units.uv: cube uv in texels; uv_scale is a factor of the texture size of the cube; face vertices: [x, y, z] in pixels of the part frame, [u, v] in texels; normal in model space; internal_direction names the face in the internal space (+Y up, +X the right side of the entity, -Z the front)
